Card Q&A.q: After I attack with this card and play a specified Digimon with its [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, can I then suspend that Digimon with ?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.Cards being revealed by this card's effect have not been placed in the trash yet, so you can't place them under the card you're trying to play while performing Assembly for it.
